notes:
• New Info button in the player (also the remote's Info key): everything about what's playing — file, video codec/profile/level, resolution, frame rate, HDR type and colour, bit depth, decoder (hardware or software), dropped frames, your display's mode and HDR support, audio codec/channels/bitrate, Atmos, decoder and whether it's passed through, subtitles, buffer and download speed
• Trailers: YouTube trailers now download a piece at a time, so they no longer stall partway; a broken or refused download picks up again from the same spot
• Logs now note download problems and playback stalls
